system: monolayer 1H-MoS2 (2H polytype layer, D3h), three-atom hexagonal cell repeated along z with vacuum; PBE; PSlibrary 1.0.0 ultrasoft pseudopotentials; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and pp.x on 2 MPI ranks

fields.kind: "scf" (self-consistent run at the given geometry) or "relax" (BFGS relaxation of all atomic positions at fixed cell, starting from the given geometry; scalar-relativistic only)
fields.relativistic: "scalar" (scalar-relativistic pseudopotentials, collinear, no spin-orbit coupling) or "full" (fully relativistic pseudopotentials, noncollinear spinors with spin-orbit coupling)
fields.lattice_A: hexagonal lattice parameter a of the unstrained cell (Angstrom): a1 = a(1, 0, 0), a2 = a(-1/2, sqrt(3)/2, 0); x is a zigzag direction, y the armchair direction
fields.strain: 2x2 symmetric in-plane strain tensor [[exx, exy], [exy, eyy]] (Cartesian x, y): cell vectors and ideal atomic sites are mapped r -> (1 + eps) r in the plane
fields.sulfur_height_A: height h of each S plane above/below the Mo plane (Angstrom); the starting value for a relaxation
fields.sulfur_shift_A: [dx, dy]: in-plane Cartesian displacement (Angstrom) of both S atoms from their strained ideal site (crystal (2/3, 1/3)); Mo sits at crystal (1/3, 2/3); the starting value for a relaxation
fields.cell_height_A: cell period c normal to the layer (Angstrom); the vacuum between periodic images is about c - 3.1 A
fields.ecutwfc_Ry: wavefunction cutoff; the charge-density cutoff is 8 x ecutwfc
fields.kmesh: n of the n x n x 1 Gamma-centred Monkhorst-Pack mesh used for the self-consistent density
fields.band_kpoints: list of at most 60 points [k1, k2]: crystal coordinates (units of the strained reciprocal vectors b1, b2, kz = 0) at which band energies are computed non-self-consistently after the scf/relaxation; may be empty

charge.rule: units = max(1, ceil((N_k * (relax_multiplier if kind is relax else 1) + band_kpoint_weight * len(band_kpoints)) * relativistic_factor * cutoff_factor / k_points_per_unit)), where N_k is the number of symmetry-distinct k points pw.x uses for this cell and scf mesh (returned as charged_k_points; it rises as strain lowers the symmetry). Requests above max_units_per_request are refused without charge.

result_units.stress_GPa: pw.x sign convention (the negative of the Cauchy stress; positive when compressed), averaged over the whole cell including the vacuum; multiply by the cell height for a 2D stress
result_units.forces_Ry_per_bohr: Cartesian forces on Mo, S_top, S_bottom
result_units.scf_mesh: number of symmetry-distinct k points and symmetry operations of the scf run, and pw.x's highest occupied and lowest unoccupied levels over the scf mesh (eV, raw eigenvalue scale)
result_units.electrostatic_potential_planar_average: pp.x plot_num=11 (bare ionic + Hartree potential) averaged over the cell area, on the FFT grid along z (eV, same reference as the eigenvalues; the layer is centred at z = c/2)
result_units.band_kpoints_results: for each band k point: crystal and Cartesian (1/A, including 2 pi) coordinates and all band energies (eV, raw pw.x eigenvalues); occupied_bands gives the number of occupied bands (13 scalar-relativistic, 26 with spin-orbit spinors)
result_units.final_positions: after a relaxation, or the input geometry for scf: Cartesian (Angstrom) and crystal coordinates, S height and in-plane S shift
